# SondeHub2

> Live tracking of weather radiosondes (weather balloons) launched every day by meteorological services worldwide: position, altitude, speed, flight path, landing prediction, burst point and receiving stations. Built on the open SondeHub network fed by radio amateurs. Free, no account, no API key.

SondeHub2 is a single-page web application (map + detail panel). Pages are client-rendered; the static HTML only contains a short description. Data is not owned by this site: it comes from the public SondeHub API (https://api.v2.sondehub.org) and its S3 archive (https://history.sondehub.org).

## Features

- Live map of radiosondes (RS41, DFM, M10, M20, iMet…), flight phase (ascent, descent, landed, lost), heading
- Per-sonde detail: altitude, vertical and horizontal speed, temperature, humidity, pressure, battery, frequency
- Flight path coloured by altitude, predicted trajectory, predicted and actual burst point, landing prediction
- Atmosphere view in 3D, charts, receiving stations, history of past flights by launch site
- 13 languages, light and dark themes, mobile layout

## Data sources

- [SondeHub](https://sondehub.org): open radiosonde tracking network and public API
- [sondehub-tracker](https://github.com/projecthorus/sondehub-tracker): original tracker this project reinterprets
